senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be distant, far, removed. Y’lamd. to Num. X, 29, quot. in Ar. (ref. to Ps. LXXIII, 27) מי שרוֹחֵק הק״בה וכ׳ (ed. Koh. שׁמִתְרַחֵק) he who keeps away from the Lord, so as not to repent.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:1">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>כרְחוֹק מזרח וכ׳</he> as far as the east is removed from the west; a. e.

senses.gloss: to remove; to alienate; to reject, expel; to loathe.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 24a:1">B. Kam. 24ᵃ</cite> top, a. e. <he>ר׳ נגיחותיו</he> if the ox did his gorings in intervals (of three days), opp. <cite ref="S01883"><he>קירב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 24a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>רִיחֲקָה ראיותיה</he>, v. <cite ref="T00015"><he>רְאִיָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 809:2">Yalk. Ps. 809</cite> (ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>זה … שׁרִחֲקוּ את הקץ</he> this alludes to Balaam and his associates, who put far off the end (the day of judgment, <cite ref="Numbers 24:17">Num. XXIV, 17</cite>), opp. <cite ref="S01890"><he>קרבו</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:6">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>ורַחֲקֵנִי מאדם רע וכ׳</he> keep me far from a bad man and a bad associate.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 5:7">Eduy. V, 7</cite> <he>מעשיך יקרבוך ומעשיך יְרַחֲקוּךָ</he> thy own doings will bring thee near (win thee friends), and thy own doings will alienate thee.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 8:7">Ib. VIII, 7</cite> <he>לרַחֵק</he>, v. <cite ref="S01883"><he>קָרֵב</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְרוּחָק</he>; pl. <he>מְרוּחָקִים</he>, <he>מְרוּחָקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 8:7">Ib.</cite> <he>המר׳ בזרוע</he>, v. <cite ref="S01883"><he>קָרֵב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:6">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא היה מר׳ וכ׳</he> which was only twelve miles off.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 94:1">Sifré Num. 94</cite> <he>מַרְחִיקִים</he>, v. <cite ref="S01883"><he>קָרֵב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:5">B. Bath. II, 5</cite> <he>מַרְחִיקִין את הסולם וכ׳</he> (neighbors) must keep a ladder removed from the (neighbor’s) dove-cote four cubits.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>אלא אם כן ה׳ ממנו וכ׳</he> unless he places (the wall) at a distance of four cubits.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 18b:3">Ib. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>על המזיק להַרְחִיק את עצמו</he> it is the duty of him who causes the damage to remove himself; (oth. opin.) <he>על הניזק להרחיק וכ׳</he> he who is injured must remove himself.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>כדי להרחיק וכ׳</he> in order to keep men away (prevent them) from sin.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 103b:17">Snh. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>שהִרְחִיקָה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00131"><he>לְגִימָה</he></cite>.
Ib. מַרְחֶקֶת וכ׳ estranges those who are near (related) &c.; a. fr.—2) to keep aloof, stay away.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:7">Ab. I, 7</cite> <he>הַרְחֵק משכן רע</he> keep aloof from a bad neighbor; a. e.—[Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ bot. <he>והרחיק על פתחו וכ׳</he>, read: <he>והִרְתִּיק</he>, v. <cite ref="T01146"><he>רָתַק</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to remove one’s self; to become a stranger.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 109a:17">Yeb. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם ידבק … ויִתְרַחֵק וכ׳</he> man should always cling to three things, and keep aloof from three things.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:4">Snh. III, 4</cite> <he>קרוב ונ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01926"><he>קָרוֹב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34b:23">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 57:19">Is. LVII, 19</cite>) <he>שהיה קרוב … ונ׳ וכ׳</he> who came near committing a sin, and withdrew himself from it. Y’lamd. l. c., v. supra; a. e.
